clips.title: The story
paras: "Time to Strike" is a Horde reconnaissance mission that transitions scouts across the Hillsbrad Foothills border to the military hub of Tarren Mill. Delivering Deathstalker Lesh's coded signal to High Executor Darthalia marks the transition from quiet surveillance to coordinated offensive operations against the local human populace.

Perched along the high ground near the border between Silverpine Forest and the Hillsbrad Foothills, Deathstalker Lesh monitors the movements of human settlers and militia in the valley below. The Deathstalkers operate as the eyes and ears of the Undercity, surveying enemy settlements before any military deployment. Rather than risk abandoning her watchpost, Lesh entrusts passing Horde travelers to relay her gathered intelligence down the road to Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Be silent and pay attention, adventurer.

I was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad. My mission is one of reconnaissance. It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once. Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:
"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."
Follow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs. Now, hurry! Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?
Superb news! Hillsbrad is ripe for attack. We can carry out our plan of destruction now. Varimathras will be pleased.
